es: Distinguir símil (as…as, like), metáfora (X is a Y) y personificación (cosas que actúan como personas) y formar cada una con sus estructuras.

teaching.en: Tom is as busy as a bee during exams.

teaching.explanationEs: as + adjetivo + as compara con algo típico de esa cualidad: es un símil.

teaching.en: The storm roared like an angry lion.

teaching.en: The exam is a mountain, and I must climb it step by step.

segments: The exam is a mountain, and I

teaching.audioText: The exam is a mountain, and I must climb it step by step.

prompt.es: Describe el mercado con metáfora, símil, personificación y una explicación.

answer.text: On a rainy Saturday the market was a grey river. People moved between the stalls like leaves in the water, and the rain danced on the roofs and whispered to the fruit. The lamps were golden apples in the dark morning, and the whole place breathed warm air. I chose the river because it shows how the crowd never stops moving. The sellers called their prices, and the smell of bread and coffee made everybody smile. It was a noisy, colourful place, and I felt happy and small in the middle of it, like a small boat on the river.
accepted: On a rainy Saturday the market was a grey river. People moved between the stalls like leaves in the water, and the rain danced on the roofs and whispered to the fruit. The lamps were golden apples in the dark morning, and the whole place breathed warm air. I chose the river because it shows how the crowd never stops moving. The sellers called their prices, and the smell of bread and coffee made everybody smile. It was a noisy, colourful place, and I felt happy and small in the middle of it, like a small boat on the river.

Yesterday the market was a big kitchen on a rainy day. The sellers shouted like cooks, and the crowd moved as slowly as a river between the stalls. The rain danced on the umbrellas and sang a quiet song. The fruit looked like small lamps, red and yellow and green. The smell of bread and coffee was a warm hug for everybody. I chose the kitchen because it shows how warm and busy the place was, even when the sky was grey. Everybody was wet, but everybody was smiling, and the market kept breathing until the evening.

feedback.es: Una buena descripción combina tres imágenes del mismo lugar y una frase con because que justifica por qué funcionan.

prompt.es: Escribe el ensayo: una metáfora extendida sobre aprender un idioma y un cierre reflexivo.

answer.text: Learning English is a long journey. At the beginning, I was at the door with no map, and I felt lost. Grammar became my map, and vocabulary became my compass. Every class was a step, and every mistake was a turn in the road that showed me a new way. Sometimes the road was long and sometimes I walked slowly, but I never stopped. Now I can understand songs, films and conversations, and I am not afraid of wrong turns. Looking back, the journey taught me that patience matters more than speed. One day I will reach my destination, but the road itself is already a good place to live.
accepted: Learning English is a long journey. At the beginning, I was at the door with no map, and I felt lost. Grammar became my map, and vocabulary became my compass. Every class was a step, and every mistake was a turn in the road that showed me a new way. Sometimes the road was long and sometimes I walked slowly, but I never stopped. Now I can understand songs, films and conversations, and I am not afraid of wrong turns. Looking back, the journey taught me that patience matters more than speed. One day I will reach my destination, but the road itself is already a good place to live.

Learning English is a garden. On the first day I planted a few words, and every morning I watered them with a little practice. Some words grew quickly, and others needed more time, but I never stopped planting. Grammar was the ground, and my mistakes were the bad plants that I took out one by one. My teacher was a patient gardener, and my friends were the sun. Sometimes it was hard, and I felt lost in the garden. Looking back, the garden taught me that patience matters more than speed. Today I have a few flowers, and I am happy, but I will keep planting new words every day.

feedback.es: Un buen ensayo abre con la metáfora, la desarrolla con elementos del mismo campo sin mezclar imágenes y cierra con una reflexión literal.

origin.text: Escribe un ensayo de 110 a 160 palabras sobre aprender un idioma. Usa una sola metáfora extendida (por ejemplo, un viaje), al menos tres elementos de esa imagen y un cierre reflexivo (por ejemplo, con «Looking back»).
